paragraphs.text: This page refers to the television series. For the book series, see "Jane and the Dragon."

Jane and the Dragon is a children's animated television series based on the books of the same name by Martin Baynton. The show is directed by Mike Fallows and the performance capture is directed by Peter Salmon; it is co-produced by Wētā Workshop (as Wētā Productions) in New Zealand and Nelvana in Canada. The series follows the comedic exploits of Jane—an adolescent girl training to be a knight—and her friend Dragon—a talking, flying, 300-year-old, fire-breathing dragon. The program originally aired on YTV in Canada and on ABC in Australia. Andrea Graham of Common Sense Media gave it 5 out of 5 stars and called it "a soaring delight." Graham also wrote: "With its lovable characters, engaging story lines, and wit reminiscent of the Shrek series, Jane and the Dragon may capture the attention of the entire family."
